facility_roles.quote: The higher energy and intensity evolution of AdA, ADONE, started the study of the electron-positron collisions physics in Frascati.

physics_goals.quote: The "Mu-Pion" Experiment (Frascati, Rome, Padua) was mainly dedicated to production of muon, pion and K meson pairs from the electron-positron annihilation.
physics_goals.value: Production of muon, pion and K meson pairs in e+e- annihilation

summary.plain: One of the four first experiments at Frascati's ADONE collider (1969), by groups from Frascati, Rome and Padua, built to measure how often electron-positron annihilation makes pairs of muons, pions and kaons.
summary.technical: Mu-Pion at ADONE (first generation, 1969): scintillation counters, spark chambers, water Cerenkov counters and iron-shielded muon identification; e+e- → μ⁺μ⁻, π⁺π⁻, K⁺K⁻ rates; Frascati, Rome and Padua.
